sources.title: Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5
sources.evidence: The June 9, 2026 announcement launches Claude Fable 5 for general use, identifies Mythos 5 as the same underlying model with different safeguards, and describes coding, knowledge-work, vision and long autonomous tasks. Reopened October 27: explicitly establishes the Fable 5/Mythos 5 same-underlying-model relationship, but supplies no nominal total or active count or sized base-model lineage.

sources.title: Claude Fable 5 - Claude Platform Docs
sources.evidence: Exact API ID claude-fable-5: June 9, 2026 release, 1M context, text/image input, text output, adaptive thinking always enabled, and hosted platform access. The current page marks this model active (legacy). Reopened October 27: the current-lineup comparison lists context, output, price, thinking, effort and cutoff; neither it nor the specifications section gives total or activated parameters.

sources.title: PDF support
sources.evidence: All active models support PDF processing; PDFs are processed through text and vision capabilities. Together with the Fable 5 active status, this supports the catalog PDF input format.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Fable 5 & Claude Mythos 5
sources.evidence: Fresh first-party PDF retrieved October 27 at 10:18:49 UTC; independently searched the complete extracted text for parameter, billion/trillion, activation, architecture, fine-tuning and distillation terms and read the relevant passages. Page 11 identifies Fable 5/Mythos 5 as configurations sharing model weights and describes pretraining/post-training without a sized base or nominal count. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning on page 14 concerns safeguards, not a published size; other parameter hits concern evaluation effort. No total or active parameter count/table was found. Prior residual-stream/layer observations on pages 177 and 192 remain insufficient to identify topology.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Fable 5.1 & Claude Mythos 5.1
sources.evidence: Fresh official redirect PDF retrieved October 27 at 10:18:48 UTC and independently text-inspected. The 212-page Fable 5.1/Mythos 5.1 card includes Fable 5/Mythos 5 in the Section 8.1 capability table, but its numbers are evaluation results, not total or activated parameters. Full-text size/parameter and lineage searches found no Fable 5 nominal count or named sized ancestor. The identical-weights statement relates 5.1 configurations to one another, not a numerical size for Fable 5.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Opus 5
sources.evidence: Fresh official redirect PDF retrieved October 27 at 10:18:51 UTC and independently text-inspected. The 194-page Opus 5 card compares earlier Fable 5/Mythos 5 capabilities but publishes no total or activated parameter column. Parameter hits concern API/evaluation effort; the trillion hit is a reference URL about market losses, not model size.

sources.title: Prompting Claude Fable 5
sources.evidence: Exact-model documentation discusses tool calls, bash/crop tools, parallel subagents, and long-running coding and knowledge-work workflows. It explicitly gives a client-tool schema and instructions for Fable 5 to call it.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Commercial terms govern Anthropic API services, grant service-use permission subject to restrictions, and prohibit reverse engineering or duplication. This supports proprietary licensing as a descriptive classification, not an open-weight license.

sources.title: Anthropic Transparency Hub - Claude Fable 5 Summary Table
sources.evidence: The exact Fable 5 entry describes text/image inputs, creative and analytical tasks, hosted access surfaces and training. Product-level voice dictation and text-to-speech are mentioned separately from the API model modalities. Its architecture section explains pretraining and post-training without disclosing topology or size. Reopened October 27: exact Fable 5 and Mythos 5 training-method summaries still provide neither nominal count nor explicit lineage to a named sized base.

sources.title: When AI builds itself
sources.evidence: Says current frontier models use Transformer architecture, but does not specifically identify Fable 5 topology. Treated as general context rather than sufficient evidence to assert an exact-model architecture.

sources.title: Models.dev Claude Fable 5 record
sources.evidence: Baseline source URL was opened as a discovery lead; technical conclusions use Anthropic sources rather than this catalog.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: Anthropic explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. This is first-party evidence about weight availability independent of the existence of a hosted API; the paper's benchmark models are newer Claude versions.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Opus 5.5
sources.evidence: Fresh first-party PDF retrieved October 27 at 10:11:48 UTC. Full-text parameter/size searches and later comparison-table inspection found no total or activated count for Fable 5. Section 8.1 is a capability-score table; subsequent Fable 5 comparisons, including FrontierCode, are evaluation scores. Parameter hits concern effort and evaluation-harness settings.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Sonnet 5.5
sources.evidence: Fresh first-party PDF retrieved October 27 at 10:11:47 UTC. Complete-text parameter, billion/trillion and activation searches found no Fable 5 nominal total or active count; parameter hits concern effort settings and the trillion hit is a market-loss reference URL.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Haiku 5.5
sources.evidence: Fresh first-party PDF retrieved October 27 at 10:11:48 UTC. Complete-text parameter, billion/trillion and activation searches found no Fable 5 nominal total or active count; parameter hits concern effort settings and the trillion hit is a market-loss reference URL.

sources.title: Anthropic Trust Center - model documentation discovery lead
sources.evidence: October 27 search results list a Claude Mythos 5 + Fable 5 Model Documentation Form. The web reader returned no document content, direct public HTTP retrieval returned 403, and no browser surface was available. The form itself was not read, so its existence supplies no evidence about whether it discloses parameters.

sources.title: OpenFable README - rejected parameter estimate lead
sources.evidence: October 27 exact-model searches surfaced approximately 10T total/878B active attributed only to independent researcher analysis. The README explicitly identifies its fable5 preset as architectural calibration requiring training from scratch. These numbers describe a third-party imitation/reference configuration and do not establish Anthropic Fable 5 specifications.

sources.title: Anthropic trust-center bundle archive - documentation-form access check
sources.evidence: Opened solely to resolve the Trust Center form lead. The archive lists the Fable 5/Mythos 5 documentation-form filename among excluded bundle members and does not serve that document. It serves training-data summaries, whose token counts are not model parameters; it cannot establish the missing parameter counts.

name.note: Official launch name and exact API model agree.

developer.note: The developer announcement and system card identify Anthropic.

family.note: Normalized catalog family key for the named Claude Fable model line; not an architecture claim.

release_date.note: Earliest launch is explicitly June 9, 2026; later restoration of access is not a new release.

open_weights.note: Anthropic explicitly states Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. Exact Fable 5 sources document hosted proprietary distribution; no newer-model technical specifications are transferred.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the hosted model under Anthropic commercial terms; no named open-weight license is claimed.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 original/later first-party checks found no nominal total count or explicit lineage to a named sized base. Fable 5 shares weights with Mythos 5, whose size is also not given. The third-party OpenFable calibration is not a developer specification; the Trust Center form could not be read.

active_parameters_b.note: Rechecked separately on October 27: original and later cards and current model comparison tables provide no activated-parameter count for Fable 5. Evaluation scores, effort controls and safeguard activations do not establish active model size; no dense/MoE equality is assumed.

architecture.note: Original-card interpretability sections disclose layered residual-stream activations but not a precise architecture or dense/MoE topology. Exact-name searches of Anthropic research, alignment research and Transformer Circuits did not yield an explicit specification. The general Transformer statement in s10 is insufficient exact-model evidence.

modalities.note: API model accepts text and images and supports PDFs as an input document format. The card says model output is text only; product dictation/TTS does not add native audio modalities.

reasoning.note: Adaptive thinking is documented as always on.

tool_call.note: Exact-model prompting documentation describes and demonstrates client tool calling.

description.value: Claude model for coding, complex knowledge work, and long-running agent workflows, with additional safeguards for high-risk domains.
description.note: Replaces the generic creative-writing emphasis with the launch and API documentation positioning; safeguards are described without claiming guaranteed control or safety.

patch.notes: Nominal total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed in the accessed Anthropic specifications and original/later system cards. Fable 5 and Mythos 5 share underlying weights, but no published size is supplied. Exact architecture remains undisclosed; safeguards may route some requests to another model.

summary: October 27 parameter-only re-audit reopened the launch, model documentation and transparency summaries; independently inspected fresh original Fable 5/Mythos 5 and later Fable 5.1, Opus 5, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 card text; and searched exact names for total/active counts and sized lineage. Retained both counts as undisclosed nulls: no nominal count or activated-parameter comparison column was found. Rejected the OpenFable calibration estimate as unrelated third-party model size. The Trust Center documentation form was listed but could not be read; the archive excludes it. Other field assessments are unchanged.
